title: feat(console): 「+ Filter」 under the report builder's data source
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8K7QoPesdUV9xG3hYEL1w6R)_

Part of #36645 — item 1 only (「＋ 筛选」 under the data source). Items 2 (show zero-count groups, waits on the maintainer's pick) and 3 (compare with the previous period, blocked by the engine card) are not touched, so the card stays open.
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：系统管理员在报表搭建页的「数据来源」下面多了「＋ 筛选」，可以按字段加条件（比如「优先级 等于 高」），图立刻按条件重画，保存后所有人看到的报表都带这个条件；以前带筛选条件的报表点「编辑」进的是旧面板，现在也进搭建页。
- 为什么做：仪表盘和报表使用体验专题里搭建页剩下的三项之一，是维护者看过的效果图三上的那一项。
- 出错会怎样：条件只影响这一张报表；搭建页改不了的复杂条件会原样保留、不会被改写；可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**The builder** (`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/`)
- `ReportBuilder` takes an optional `filter` slot, drawn under the data source picker while a data source is bound. Host-controlled like the name box: the filterable fields are the dataset object's and the filter's conversion is the console's one shared bridge, so neither is read in this package.
- The model's doc says what it already did: switching the data source clears `runtimeFilter` (the old object's fields mean nothing on the new one). Now pinned.

**The console host** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`)
- `ReportBuilderHost` fills the slot with the existing `FilterConditionField` (the dataset designer's editor: the list toolbar's `FilterBuilder` behind the `datasetFilterCondition` bridge), bound to the report's `runtimeFilter`. Each committed edit lands in the draft, so the preview redraws at once; the last condition removed drops the key (no `{}` stored).
- `reportFilterFields.ts` (new): the fields offered are the dataset OBJECT's own fields, because `runtimeFilter` is keyed by object fields at the dataset door (not by dimensions). Read through the data source's `getObjectSchema` and mapped by the list Filter panel's mapping (`conditionCandidatesOf`), so labels are translated, a select offers its options and a lookup its record picker. Hidden fields and virtual (formula) fields are left out (the dataset door refuses a filter on a formula field with 400 INVALID_FIELD); business fields come before system ones (so "Add filter" seeds on a business field); a record-mode amount's currency pairing is dropped because the bridge cannot hold its companion row.
- The shared bridge `datasetFilterCondition.conditionToGroup` reads `$and` as the group only when it is the ONLY top-level key: `{ $and: [...], amount: {...} }` or `{ $and: [...], $not: {...} }` (valid spec shapes) are now not representable, and a logical operator in a field slot (`$not`) is not a row. Before, the siblings were ignored, the filter opened as editable, and the next edit dropped them. This also closes the same hole in the dataset designer.
- `FilterConditionField` gains two optional props: `addLabel` (while empty, the trigger is a small 「＋ 筛选」 link like 「＋ 再分一层」; with rows it keeps the counted box) and an optional `label`.
- `opensInBuilder`: a dataset report with a saved filter now opens in the builder when the filter is one the editor can hold (field conditions joined by AND, read by the editor's own `conditionToGroup`); an OR, a nested group, two operators on one field, or `$and` beside other keys still keep the inspector panel.

**Exports and strings**
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` exports `conditionCandidatesOf`, `conditionOptionsOf` and the `ConditionCandidateField` type (the one mapping, reused rather than copied).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `report.builder.source.addFilter`, `filterAdvanced`, `filterLoading`, `filterNoFields` in all 11 locales.
- Changeset: `.changeset/36645-report-builder-filter.md` (patch; plugin-report, app-shell, plugin-list, i18n).

Read first (by risk): `ReportView.tsx` `opensInBuilder` (which reports now route to the builder) · `reportFilterFields.ts` (which fields are offered) · `FilterConditionField.tsx` (shared with the dataset designer; additive props only).

Two-minute check: open any dataset report's 「编辑」, click 「＋ 筛选」 → 「添加筛选」, pick a field and a value — the chart redraws at once; Save, reopen 「编辑」 — the trigger reads 「1 个条件」.

## Tests

- `plugin-report` `reportBuilder-36374.test.tsx`, new top-level describe 「the report filter under the data source (objectstack#36645)」: the slot draws under the data source only once one is bound; a filter set/cleared reaches the preview's `queryDataset` selection at once and the report stays spec-valid; switching data source drops the filter, re-picking the same one keeps it.
- `app-shell` `ReportBuilderHost.filter-36645.test.tsx` (new; real host, builder, `FilterConditionField`, `FilterBuilder`): field list (hidden and formula fields out, system last, options and lookup target kept, no currency pairing); 「＋ Filter」 offered and the object definition read; a condition typed is in the preview query and in what Save hands over; an existing filter opens counted, an edit saves, Clear all saves NO `runtimeFilter`; a filter the editor cannot hold is shown as kept and saved byte-identical, both by shape and by field type (`$gt` on a text field, once the fields are read).
- `app-shell` `datasetFilterCondition.test.ts`: `$and` with a field or `$not` sibling, a non-array `$and`, and a top-level `$not` are not representable; a lone `$and` still round-trips.
- `app-shell` `ReportView.saveRefusal-11583.test.tsx`: the `opensInBuilder` pin that asserted "a saved filter keeps the panel" is replaced by the new routing (holdable filter → builder; OR / nested / two-operator / `$and` with siblings / `$not` → panel). That old assertion encoded the premise this card changes; the other shapes it pinned (cross-tab, several values) are kept.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- Targeted on bdf493b7: the bridge's whole `inspectors/` folder plus the three files above — Test Files 251 passed (251), Tests 3297 passed | 1 skipped (3298).
- Red without the fix: on ba679290, reverting the builder, host and routing sources turned 7 of the 8 first-round pins red; on the rework, reverting `datasetFilterCondition.ts` and `reportFilterFields.ts` turned the 3 new pins red (bridge `$and` siblings, routing table, field list).
- Package suites and derived gates: reported on the thread hand-off with the head they ran on.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Browser run** (showcase app, zh-CN, admin): on 「按状态统计工时（图表）」 「＋ 筛选」 sits under 「数据来源」; 「优先级 等于 高」 redraws the bars from five statuses to two at once (the dataset query's SQL gains the priority condition). On a new report: the condition saved (`runtimeFilter: { priority: { $eq: 'high' } }` read back from the served report), 「编辑」 reopened in the builder with 「1 个条件」, Clear all brought back 「＋ 筛选」 and the saved report carries no `runtimeFilter`. Six frames are attached on the project thread (GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only).
- **Pre-existing, not this PR:** Save on a report that ships in an app package (the showcase's own reports) is refused 403 by the metadata write door (ADR-0146 D11: a package-shipped item must be saved into the `.custom` overlay package). Measured with a chart-type change and no filter on the same report — same refusal, so it is the builder's save path, not the filter. Filed as #36716.
- First cut is base-object fields only; relationship paths (`account.region`) are out of reach, as they are in the dataset designer's filters.
- The field list reads the object through the console's data source with no per-field read check; the builder is admin-only today.

## Verification

- CI: the PR's check-runs on the head.
- Screenshots: on the project thread.
